summary: CheckYourself audited itself as a public, file-first diagnostic system. Local P2/P3 findings are remediated, the public GitHub repo is live, and remote Actions proof passed.

language_mode.reason: The public product is English-first, while KyaniteLabs exposes an ES surface and the user requested bilingual accessibility.

coverage.evidence: README, START_HERE, and paste prompt define users and outputs.
Static Markdown workspace with Python validator and dashboard templates.
Dashboard docs, template, and smoke-check guidance are present.
No backend runtime in public product.
No auth/session runtime.
No database or migrations.
No multitenant runtime.
Gitleaks passed; local/generated/private paths are ignored.
Secret scan passed and CI installs and runs gitleaks.
Public product collects no data and warns against secret/private output.
Public validator, CLI unit tests, syntax checks, link checks, schema checks, and dashboard smoke guidance are present.
Remote GitHub Actions passed on KyaniteLabs/checkyourself run 26628784699.
Public repository is live at https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/checkyourself.
No cloud runtime or IaC.
Progressive context-loading and token-efficiency rules are documented.
No service workload; resilience is context-size control.
No runtime observability needed, but public issue/maintainer process is not defined.
Static repo; git history and releases are recovery model after publication.
Prompt governance plus dogfood fixture now exist.
Learning-plan template and real dogfood learning output exist.

findings.title: Scanner-generated context could dirty repo root
findings.plain_risk: Maintainers could accidentally commit local generated context.
findings.next_step: Keep ignore pattern covered by validator.

findings.title: Manifest dashboard paths drifted from docs
findings.plain_risk: Agents could choose the wrong dashboard mode.
findings.next_step: Keep manifest and dashboard docs validated together.

findings.title: CI was narrower than dogfood verification
findings.plain_risk: Public regressions could pass a weaker CI gate.
findings.next_step: Keep remote Actions green after changes.

findings.title: Public GitHub launch was not proven
findings.plain_risk: The local repo was ready, but the public repo and Actions run had not been proven.
findings.next_step: Optional: tag a release when launch copy is final.

findings.title: Duplicate token-efficiency docs
findings.plain_risk: Duplicate docs can drift over time.
findings.next_step: Keep the short doc as a pointer.

findings.title: Private v1.3 release note looked current
findings.plain_risk: Private launch materials could confuse future packaging.
findings.next_step: Use root changelog for current release truth.

findings.title: Scanner header referenced old path
findings.plain_risk: Maintainers could chase stale script locations.

findings.title: No agent eval fixture
findings.plain_risk: Prompt regressions are harder to notice.
findings.next_step: Run the broken-app fixture through target agents.

findings.title: No dashboard smoke check guidance
findings.plain_risk: A dashboard could parse but still be visually wrong.
findings.next_step: Use the smoke checklist for generated dashboards.

findings.title: Manifest modes were noisy
findings.plain_risk: Downstream agents may over-index on duplicate dashboard modes.

next_approval: Public repo and Actions proof are complete. Next decision: tag a release or collect first user feedback.

learning_priorities.concept: Keep generated files out of the public repo
learning_priorities.plain_english: Temporary generated files can be useful locally but confusing or risky when published.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: Los archivos temporales pueden servir localmente, pero confundir o exponer cosas si se publican.
learning_priorities.why: Maintainer tools need safe defaults so launch prep does not pollute public commits.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Run each Creator Kit script once, then decide whether any new file belongs in source, ignore rules, or an output folder.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Ejecuta cada script del Creator Kit una vez y decide si cada archivo nuevo va en codigo, en .gitignore, o en una carpeta de salida.
learning_priorities.success_signal: `git status --short` shows only intentional source changes.
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: GitHub is the platform owner for .gitignore guidance in GitHub repositories.
learning_priorities.video_trust_note: Established programming educator; canonical written source is GitHub Docs.

learning_priorities.concept: Make one place the source of truth
learning_priorities.plain_english: If routing docs disagree, an AI assistant may follow the wrong sign.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: Si las guias se contradicen, un asistente de IA puede seguir la senal equivocada.
learning_priorities.why: Agents treat manifests and context files as routing truth.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Compare README, CONTEXT.md, dashboard docs, and checkyourself.manifest.json for contradictions.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Compara README, CONTEXT.md, los docs del dashboard y el manifiesto para quitar contradicciones.
learning_priorities.success_signal: A new agent can answer which file to use without choosing between conflicting instructions.
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: Diataxis is the original documentation-system source for this concept.
learning_priorities.youtube_title: DjangoCon 2020 | What You Need to Know About Your Documentation - Daniele Procida
learning_priorities.video_trust_note: Diataxis creator on an official conference channel.

learning_priorities.concept: Make CI prove the same things you prove locally
learning_priorities.plain_english: CI is the robot checklist that runs when you push changes.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: CI es la lista automatica que corre cuando subes cambios.
learning_priorities.why: Checks used to call a repo ready should be represented in CI or documented as manual gates.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: List every launch command. Put safe repeatable checks in .github/workflows/validate.yml.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Haz una lista de los comandos de lanzamiento y pon los repetibles en .github/workflows/validate.yml.
learning_priorities.success_signal: A broken JSON file, Python syntax error, or accidental generated file fails before release.
learning_priorities.source_title: GitHub Docs: Quickstart for GitHub Actions
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: GitHub owns GitHub Actions and maintains the official quickstart.
learning_priorities.youtube_title: How to use GitHub Actions | GitHub for Beginners

learning_priorities.plain_english: A clean local repo is not the same as a public repo with passing Actions and readable release notes.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: Un repo limpio en tu maquina no es lo mismo que un repo publico con Actions en verde y notas de release claras.
learning_priorities.why: Local green status is not the same as GitHub Actions passing after push.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: After publishing, open the repo as a visitor and check README, images, Actions, and release notes.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Despues de publicar, abre el repo como visitante y revisa README, imagenes, Actions y notas de release.
learning_priorities.success_signal: A stranger can use the public GitHub page without private context from this workspace.
learning_priorities.source_title: GitHub Docs: Managing releases in a repository
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: GitHub maintains the release feature and its official documentation.
learning_priorities.youtube_title: How to automatically generate release notes for your project #Shorts

learning_priorities.concept: Test the AI with one known-bad example
learning_priorities.plain_english: A diagnostic prompt needs a fake risky app to prove it catches the right things.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: Un prompt diagnostico necesita una app falsa con riesgos conocidos para probar que detecta lo importante.
learning_priorities.why: Prompt systems need small known-bad inputs to catch shallow diagnostic behavior.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Run samples/dogfood-fixture-broken-app.md through one AI tool and compare its answer to the required coverage matrix.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Ejecuta samples/dogfood-fixture-broken-app.md en una herramienta de IA y compara la respuesta con la matriz de cobertura.
learning_priorities.success_signal: The AI does not stop at top three issues and does not start fixing before approval.
learning_priorities.source_title: OpenAI Cookbook: Getting started with OpenAI Evals
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: OpenAI maintains the Cookbook and the example addresses AI evaluation directly.
learning_priorities.youtube_title: Evals in Action: From Frontier Research to Production Applications

learning_priorities.concept: Check visual outputs like a user
learning_priorities.plain_english: Valid HTML can still be hard to read. Open it and inspect it like a person would.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: HTML valido puede ser dificil de leer. Abrelo y revisalo como lo haria una persona.
learning_priorities.why: The dashboard is part of the product experience, not just a generated file.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Open the generated dashboard, compare it to the Markdown report, and save a screenshot when it is part of launch proof.
learning_priorities.do_this_next_other_language: Abre el dashboard generado, comparalo con el reporte Markdown y guarda una captura si es prueba de lanzamiento.
learning_priorities.success_signal: The screenshot shows the score, finding counts, backlog, and learning section without broken layout.
learning_priorities.why_this_source_is_trusted: Chrome for Developers maintains Lighthouse documentation.
